description: I’d love the opportunity to connect with you in person. Join me for a relaxed morning of coffee and conversation at Lolly’s Café. This is your chance to share your thoughts, ask questions, and talk about the future of our community and the 9th Bristol District.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Chester Tam Committee to Elect
title: Meet & Greet: Let’s Chat Over Coffee | CHESTER TAM
